name: Huayu: Baihe
source:
Lingua Fleur: Lily is a tale of a rather unlikely friendship between the introverted Yuyi and the sociable Yile. This is not your typical yuri romance story, but one which focuses more on personal growth.

Unlike many visual novels, this story is set in a Chinese college. While not obvious from first glance, this is a Chinese-language visual novel.

[Excerpt From [url=https://www.nookgaming.com/lingua-fleur-lily-review/]NookGaming.com[/url]]
translation:
《花语：百合》讲述了内向的雨一和善于交际的一乐之间一段不太可能的友谊的故事。这不是典型的尤里浪漫故事，而是更注重个人成长的故事。

与许多视觉小说不同，这个故事发生在中国的一所大学。虽然乍一看并不明显，但这是一部中文视觉小说。

[摘自 [url=https://www.nookgaming.com/lingua-fleur-lily-review/]NookGaming.com[/url]]
